This Terraform configuration sets up a VPC with a public subnet and a security group for database access. It also creates a PostgreSQL database instance within the VPC, using AWS Lightsail. The database instance is configured to use the specified version (17.1) and capacity (5GB), and it is secured by the designated security group. The configuration ensures that the database is accessible from the public subnet.

### Terraform HCL Program

```hcl
provider "aws" {
  region = "us-west-2"
}

resource "aws_vpc" "main_vpc" {
  cidr_block           = "10.0.0.0/16"
  enable_dns_support   = true
  enable_dns_hostnames = true
}

resource "aws_subnet" "public_subnet" {
  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.main_vpc.id
  cidr_block              = "10.0.1.0/24"
  map_public_ip_on_launch = true
  availability_zone       = "us-west-2a"
}

resource "aws_security_group" "db_security_group" {
  name        = "db_security_group"
  description = "Security group for database access"
  vpc_id      = aws_vpc.main_vpc.id

  ingress {
    from_port   = 5432
    to_port     = 5432
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]  # Adjust this for production environments
  }

  egress {
    from_port   = 0
    to_port     = 0
    protocol    = "-1"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }
}

resource "aws_lightsail_database" "postgresql_db" {
  blueprint_id          = "postgres_17_1"
  bundle_id             = "micro_5gb"
  master_database_name  = "my_postgres_db"
  master_username       = "admin"
  master_password       = "securepassword123"
```

### Description of the Terraform Program

The Terraform program sets up a Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) with a public subnet and a security group configured for database access. It then creates a PostgreSQL database instance within the VPC using AWS Lightsail, ensuring that the database is accessible and secured by the designated security group. The database is configured to skip the final snapshot and has an identifier name of "dolphinscheduler".

### Terraform HCL Program

```hcl
provider "aws" {
  region = "us-west-2"
}

resource "aws_vpc" "main_vpc" {
  cidr_block           = "10.0.0.0/16"
  enable_dns_support   = true
  enable_dns_hostnames = true
}

resource "aws_subnet" "public_subnet" {
  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.main_vpc.id
  cidr_block              = "10.0.1.0/24"
  map_public_ip_on_launch = true
  availability_zone       = "us-west-2a"
}

resource "aws_security_group" "db_security_group" {
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main_vpc.id
  name   = "db_security_group"

  ingress {
    from_port   = 5432
    to_port     = 5432
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }

  egress {
    from_port   = 0
    to_port     = 0
    protocol    = "-1"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }
}

  relational_database_name = "dolphinscheduler"
  blueprint_id             = "postgres_17_1"
  bundle_id                = "micro_1_0"
  master_database_name     = "mydatabase"
  master_username          = "admin"
  master_password          = "securepassword"
  availability_zone        = aws_subnet.public_subnet.availability_zone
  skip_final_snapshot      = true
}
```
